parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a structural sample-app marker that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The production copy of `DebugMetricsProvider.measureMemoryUsage` lives in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`) and is the authoritative implementation. The `WallpaperSampleApp` copy is a deliberate in-context mirror for demonstration purposes; consolidating it into a shared location would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rules are designed to prevent.
